description:
VIDA LAB is a private wellness reflection and health-organization app. An account is optional; reviewers can use the core app without signing in. The app allows users to record check-ins, review patterns, use Ask VIDA, create personal experiments, prepare summaries for medical appointments, save educational research, and view weekly reports.

Apple Health access is optional and is requested only when the user chooses to use health-import features. VIDA LAB requests read access only. Personal health information is designed to remain private; signed-in backups are encrypted before upload.

VIDA LAB is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, prescribe, or replace professional medical care. Pattern information is presented as correlation and reflection rather than medical causation.

VIDA+ subscriptions use Apple In-App Purchase. Account creation and Apple Health access are not required to explore the core app.

Daily Signals — under 60 seconds
Log energy, sleep, mood, pain, cycle phase and symptoms in a few taps. Every check-in gives you something back: what's changed from your usual range, and explainers on what might connect the signals you just logged.

Pattern Map
Once you've tracked enough, Vida surfaces associations in your own data — cycle and headaches, sleep and mood, movement and energy. Always as what you reported, never as a cause. You've reported headaches more often after shorter nights is a true statement. Poor sleep causes your migraines is not, and Vida won't say it.

Doctor Prep
Turn months of tracking into a clear, factual summary you can print and bring to an appointment: how often, how severe, when it tends to happen, what it shows up alongside, how much it disrupted. Not a diagnosis — the information you need to be understood in twelve minutes.

Vida Explainers
Every article shows who wrote it, who reviewed it, when the evidence was last checked, and how strong that evidence is — established, emerging or mixed. Written in plain language, with sources you can open.

Vida Experiments (Vida+)
Structured two-week self-experiments — sleep, movement, hydration, stress — that teach the method as you go: baseline, variables, confounders, limitations. Understanding how evidence works is the point, not just collecting data.

What Vida Lab does not do
Vida does not diagnose. Vida does not tell you whether you have a condition. Vida does not replace a healthcare professional. It helps you notice patterns, understand science, organise information and prepare better questions.

Your body isn't an advertising profile
No health advertising. No selling personal health data. No ad or behavioural tracking anywhere near your symptoms, your patterns, or your health profile. Ever.

Free and Vida+
Free, permanently: all Explainers, The Vida Brief, Daily Signals, cycle and symptom tracking, 30-day history, basic insights, one Vida Experiment.
Vida+: unlimited history, the full Pattern Map, Doctor Prep summaries, unlimited Vida Experiments, custom signals and your saved research library.

One account across the app and vidalab.co. Subscribe on either and you're a member on both.

Vida Lab is for adults 16 and over. Educational only; not medical advice and not a medical device. For a medical emergency, contact emergency services.
promotionalText: Track how you actually feel, see your own patterns, and walk into your next appointment with a clear summary instead of a guess. Free to start. No diagnosis, no ads.
